code.description: SMTP status code received as a result of the ESP session

attempt-no.description: The current attempt number trying to deliver the message to the ESP

enhanced-code.description: A more specific SMTP error code from the ESP

mxhost.description: The mailing host connected to for the SMTP session

tls.description: True if the SMTP session was performed over a TLS connection with the ESP

utf8.description: True if the SMTP session was able to use UTF-8 encoding

first-delivery-attempt-seconds.description: Time elapsed between when the message is accepted by us and the first delivery attempt to the email service provider (ESP)

session-seconds.description: The time, in seconds, the SMTP session for this message took

retry-seconds.description: If the message failed for a reason that can be retried, the number of seconds between retry attempts. This value changes as the number of retries grows!
